buckets.description: Per dataset: bucket name, protection profile, and the key used (null means SSE-S3).

kms_key_arns.description: Customer managed KMS key ARN per data domain.

account_id.description: AWS account ID that owns the keys. Passed in rather than looked up so the module plans offline.

break_glass_role_arn.description: The only principal allowed to schedule key deletion (matches the SCP exception in code/policy/aws-scp/).

custom_key_store_id.description: Optional CloudHSM or external (XKS) custom key store ID. When set, keys for domains that hold pp3 data are created in it.

datasets.description:
Map of dataset name to its data tags. Each dataset gets one storage
container encrypted according to its protection profile:
  pp1 (public, internal)  provider-managed encryption
  pp2 (confidential)      customer-managed key for the data domain
  pp3 (restricted)        customer-managed key for the data domain plus the
                          module's additional pp3 controls
protection_profile may be set higher than the classification requires,
never lower.

deletion_window_in_days.description: Waiting period before a scheduled key deletion completes (7 to 30).

environment.description: Environment name, used in resource names and the environment tag.

key_admin_arns.description: IAM principals that administer keys (no encrypt or decrypt). Must include the principal running Terraform, or the key policy lockout check fails.

key_user_arns.description: Map of data domain to IAM principals allowed to use that domain's key through S3 (encrypt, decrypt, generate data key).

name_prefix.description: Prefix for bucket names and key aliases (S3 bucket names are global).

region.description: Region of the buckets; used for the kms:ViaService condition.

rotation_period_in_days.description: Automatic rotation period for customer managed keys (90 to 2560).
